title: 高反射雷射鏡片
summary: 雷射鏡片與一般高反射膜的差別在於損耗以 ppm 計、功率以損傷門檻計：本課從 1 − R = T + A + S 的損耗帳出發，分析四分之一波堆內的駐波場與損傷起點、超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷、離子束濺鍍與退火對吸收的要求，再用光腔衰盪、光熱吸收與 ISO 21254 損傷測試驗證，最後處理高功率熱效應、安裝污染與規格交接。
summaryEn: A laser mirror differs from an ordinary high reflector in that loss is counted in ppm and power in damage threshold: starting from the loss ledger 1 − R = T + A + S, the course analyses the standing-wave field and damage origin inside a quarter-wave stack, superpolished substrates and nodular defects, ion-beam sputtering and annealing requirements for absorption, then verifies with cavity ring-down, photothermal absorption and ISO 21254 damage testing, and finishes with high-power thermal effects, mounting contamination and specification handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 1064 nm Q 開關雷射腔鏡練習：Ta₂O₅/SiO₂（2.10/1.45）於熔融石英，設計 (HL)¹⁵H 加半波 SiO₂ 保護層。穿透：(2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴，Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵，T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm。散射：基板 σ = 0.15 nm，S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm；吸收：退火後 A ≈ 2 ppm；1 − R ≈ 25 ppm，R ≈ 99.9975%。衰盪驗收：L = 0.5 m 的雙鏡腔 τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs，量測 1% 精度對應 0.25 ppm。損傷：證書 20 J/cm²（10 ns、1-on-1），使用 8 ns 換算 17.9 J/cm²；200 mJ、w = 2 mm 的峰值能量密度 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm²，安全係數 5.6。熱效應：1 kHz 重複率平均功率 200 W，吸收 2 ppm 即 0.4 mW，ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K，可忽略。駐波場：第一個 H/L 界面 |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91，保護層中央 1.90。數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Cavity-mirror exercise for a 1064 nm Q-switched laser: Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (2.10/1.45) on fused silica, design (HL)¹⁵H plus a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat. Transmission: (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴, Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵, T ≈ 4/Y ≈ 20 ppm. Scatter: substrate σ = 0.15 nm gives S ≈ (4π×0.15/1064)² ≈ 3.1 ppm; absorption after annealing A ≈ 2 ppm; 1 − R ≈ 25 ppm, R ≈ 99.9975%. Ring-down acceptance: a two-mirror cavity with L = 0.5 m has τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 2.5×10⁻⁵) ≈ 66.7 µs, and 1% timing precision resolves 0.25 ppm. Damage: certificate 20 J/cm² (10 ns, 1-on-1) scales to 17.9 J/cm² at the 8 ns in use; a 200 mJ pulse with w = 2 mm has peak fluence 2×0.2/(π×0.04) ≈ 3.2 J/cm², safety factor 5.6. Thermal: at 1 kHz the average power is 200 W, 2 ppm absorption is 0.4 mW and ΔT ≈ 0.0004/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 0.06 K, negligible. Standing wave: |E/E₀|² ≈ 0.91 at the first H/L interface and 1.90 in the middle of the overcoat. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product specification.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限」與「駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射鏡的反射率不是「越接近 1 越好」的單一數字，而是 1 − R = T + A + S 三項的總和：穿透 T 由膜堆的導納決定，可以靠加層數無限壓低；吸收 A 由材料的消光係數與膜內場分佈決定；散射 S 由基板與膜層的粗糙度與缺陷決定。離子束濺鍍的 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ 鏡可以把 A 與 S 各壓到 1 到 5 ppm，所以 T 低於幾個 ppm 之後再加層數已無意義，規格應改寫成「T ≤ 10 ppm、A ≤ 2 ppm、S ≤ 3 ppm」而不是「R ≥ 99.999%」。腔內功率數十 kW 的系統裡，幾個 ppm 的吸收就是數十 mW 的熱，這是損耗帳必須分項的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A laser mirror's reflectance is not a single number to push toward 1 but the sum 1 − R = T + A + S: transmission T is set by the stack admittance and can be driven down without limit by adding layers; absorption A by the materials' extinction coefficients and the field distribution inside the stack; scatter S by substrate and film roughness and defects. Ion-beam-sputtered Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ mirrors reach A and S of 1 to 5 ppm each, so once T is below a few ppm further layers are pointless, and the specification should read T ≤ 10 ppm, A ≤ 2 ppm, S ≤ 3 ppm rather than R ≥ 99.999%. With tens of kilowatts circulating in a cavity, a few ppm of absorption is tens of milliwatts of heat, which is why the ledger must be itemised. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Glass | (HL)ᴺH | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s，T ≈ 4n₀/Y。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For glass | (HL)ᴺH | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s and T ≈ 4n₀/Y.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多加幾對膜層就能讓雷射鏡的損耗無限趨近於零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding more layer pairs drives a laser mirror's loss arbitrarily close to zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Glass | (HL)ᴺH | air 的導納 Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s，T ≈ 4n₀/Y。Ta₂O₅/SiO₂（2.10/1.45）於熔融石英（1.45）、1064 nm：N = 15（31 層）時 (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴，Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵，T ≈ 20 ppm；N = 20（41 層）時 T ≈ 0.5 ppm。若 A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，31 層鏡 R = 1 − 25 ppm = 99.9975%，41 層鏡只升到 99.99945%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For glass | (HL)ᴺH | air the admittance is Y = (n_H/n_L)^{2N}·n_H²/n_s and T ≈ 4n₀/Y. For Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (2.10/1.45) on fused silica (1.45) at 1064 nm: with N = 15 (31 layers), (2.10/1.45)³⁰ ≈ 6.7×10⁴, Y ≈ 6.7×10⁴ × 4.41/1.45 ≈ 2.0×10⁵ and T ≈ 20 ppm; with N = 20 (41 layers) T ≈ 0.5 ppm. If A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm, the 31-layer mirror has R = 1 − 25 ppm = 99.9975% and the 41-layer mirror only rises to 99.99945%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致；比較 31 層與 41 層樣品的 1 − R，確認差異被 A + S 的底限掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%; compare 1 − R of 31- and 41-layer samples to confirm the difference is masked by the A + S floor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致；比較 31 層與 41 層樣品的 1 − R，確認差異被 A + S 的底限掩蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%; compare 1 − R of 31- and 41-layer samples to confirm the difference is masked by the A + S floor. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格只寫 R ≥ 99.99% 並以分光光度計驗收，實際鏡片吸收 50 ppm，在 20 kW 腔內功率下吸收 1 W，熱透鏡使模態失穩，鏡片在數小時後損傷。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A specification of only R ≥ 99.99% verified by spectrophotometer passes a mirror absorbing 50 ppm; at 20 kW circulating power it absorbs 1 W, thermal lensing destabilises the mode and the mirror fails after hours.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致；比較 31 層與 41 層樣品的 1 − R，確認差異被 A + S 的底限掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%; compare 1 − R of 31- and 41-layer samples to confirm the difference is masked by the A + S floor.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雷射鏡的損耗帳與穿透極限」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror"?
options: 分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。
optionsEn: Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance.
quiz.explanation: 分別量 T（以功率計在高功率下量穿透光，或以光腔衰盪求 1 − R）、A（光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折）與 S（總積分散射儀），確認三項相加與衰盪得到的 1 − R 在 20% 內一致；比較 31 層與 41 層樣品的 1 − R，確認差異被 A + S 的底限掩蓋。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure T (transmitted power at high incident power, or 1 − R by cavity ring-down), A (photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection) and S (total integrated scatter) separately and confirm that their sum agrees with the ring-down 1 − R within 20%; compare 1 − R of 31- and 41-layer samples to confirm the difference is masked by the A + S floor. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.titleEn: Loss ledger and transmission limit of a laser mirror: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ppm 損耗帳：T、A、S」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “The ppm loss ledger: T, A and S” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格只寫 R ≥ 99.99% 並以分光光度計驗收，實際鏡片吸收 50 ppm，在 20 kW 腔內功率下吸收 1 W，熱透鏡使模態失穩，鏡片在數小時後損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A specification of only R ≥ 99.99% verified by spectrophotometer passes a mirror absorbing 50 ppm; at 20 kW circulating power it absorbs 1 W, thermal lensing destabilises the mode and the mirror fails after hours. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With tens of kilowatts circulating in a cavity, a few ppm of absorption is tens of milliwatts of heat, which is why the ledger must be itemised.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多加幾對膜層就能讓雷射鏡的損耗無限趨近於零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding more layer pairs drives a laser mirror's loss arbitrarily close to zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Standing-wave field, damage origin and material band gap: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高反射堆前方的入射波與反射波形成駐波，進入膜堆後逐對衰減。以高折射率層結尾的四分之一波堆在空氣界面是波節，場強最大值落在第一個 H/L 界面，之後每深一對就乘上 (n_L/n_H)²，所以吸收與損傷幾乎都由最上面幾對決定。奈秒脈衝的損傷由缺陷吸收引發熱爆裂，飛秒脈衝則由多光子與雪崩游離主導，門檻隨材料能隙上升：SiO₂ 約 9 eV、HfO₂ 約 5.6 eV、Ta₂O₅ 約 4 eV、TiO₂ 約 3.3 eV，因此高損傷門檻鏡用 HfO₂/SiO₂，最低吸收鏡用 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The incident and reflected waves in front of a high reflector form a standing wave that decays pair by pair inside the stack. A quarter-wave stack ending in a high-index layer has a node at the air interface, the field maximum sits at the first H/L interface, and each deeper pair multiplies the intensity by (n_L/n_H)², so absorption and damage are governed almost entirely by the top few pairs. Nanosecond damage is initiated by defect absorption and thermal explosion, while femtosecond damage is dominated by multiphoton and avalanche ionisation whose threshold rises with band gap: about 9 eV for SiO₂, 5.6 eV for HfO₂, 4 eV for Ta₂O₅ and 3.3 eV for TiO₂, which is why high-threshold mirrors use HfO₂/SiO₂ and lowest-absorption mirrors Ta₂O₅/SiO₂. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：矩陣計算（Ta₂O₅/SiO₂、(HL)¹⁵H、1064 nm）：空氣界面 |E/E₀|² = 0，第一個 H/L 界面 0.91，第二個 0.43，第三個 0.21，衰減比 (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48；前五對承擔約 95% 的場能。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Matrix calculation for Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (HL)¹⁵H at 1064 nm: |E/E₀|² = 0 at the air interface, 0.91 at the first H/L interface, 0.43 at the second and 0.21 at the third, a ratio of (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48 per pair, with the top five pairs carrying about 95% of the field energy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射損傷總是從鏡片最外面的表面開始。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Laser damage always starts at the outermost surface of the mirror." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Standing-wave field, damage origin and material band gap: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：矩陣計算（Ta₂O₅/SiO₂、(HL)¹⁵H、1064 nm）：空氣界面 |E/E₀|² = 0，第一個 H/L 界面 0.91，第二個 0.43，第三個 0.21，衰減比 (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48；前五對承擔約 95% 的場能。在最外層加一層半波 SiO₂ 保護層，T 不變（20 ppm），但 SiO₂ 層中央出現 |E/E₀|² ≈ 1.90 的波腹，第一個 H/L 界面仍為 0.91，所以保護層只有在 SiO₂ 門檻遠高於 Ta₂O₅ 時才改善損傷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Matrix calculation for Ta₂O₅/SiO₂ (HL)¹⁵H at 1064 nm: |E/E₀|² = 0 at the air interface, 0.91 at the first H/L interface, 0.43 at the second and 0.21 at the third, a ratio of (1.45/2.10)² ≈ 0.48 per pair, with the top five pairs carrying about 95% of the field energy. Adding a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat leaves T unchanged at 20 ppm but places an antinode of |E/E₀|² ≈ 1.90 in the middle of the SiO₂ while the first H/L interface stays at 0.91, so the overcoat helps only because SiO₂'s threshold is far above Ta₂O₅'s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用薄膜軟體輸出駐波場分佈並標出各界面的場強，與上述數值核對；對同一膜系做有無半波保護層的 1-on-1 損傷測試，比較門檻與損傷形貌，用聚焦離子束截面確認損傷是否起始於第一個 H/L 界面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Output the standing-wave profile from thin-film software, mark the field at every interface and check against the values above; run 1-on-1 damage tests on the same stack with and without the half-wave overcoat, compare thresholds and damage morphology, and confirm by focused-ion-beam cross-section whether damage starts at the first H/L interface.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Standing-wave field, damage origin and material band gap: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用薄膜軟體輸出駐波場分佈並標出各界面的場強，與上述數值核對；對同一膜系做有無半波保護層的 1-on-1 損傷測試，比較門檻與損傷形貌，用聚焦離子束截面確認損傷是否起始於第一個 H/L 界面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Output the standing-wave profile from thin-film software, mark the field at every interface and check against the values above; run 1-on-1 damage tests on the same stack with and without the half-wave overcoat, compare thresholds and damage morphology, and confirm by focused-ion-beam cross-section whether damage starts at the first H/L interface. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：為了拓寬波段改用 TiO₂/SiO₂ 製作 355 nm 高反射鏡，TiO₂ 的能隙 3.3 eV 低於光子能量 3.5 eV，膜層直接吸收，門檻降到原來的十分之一且數分鐘內出現燒蝕。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Switching to TiO₂/SiO₂ for a 355 nm high reflector to widen the band puts TiO₂'s 3.3 eV gap below the 3.5 eV photon energy; the film absorbs directly, the threshold drops tenfold and ablation appears within minutes.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 駐波場分佈、損傷起點與材料能隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Standing-wave field, damage origin and material band gap: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膜堆內的駐波場與第一個 H/L 界面」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Standing-wave field and the first H/L interface” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 為了拓寬波段改用 TiO₂/SiO₂ 製作 355 nm 高反射鏡，TiO₂ 的能隙 3.3 eV 低於光子能量 3.5 eV，膜層直接吸收，門檻降到原來的十分之一且數分鐘內出現燒蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Switching to TiO₂/SiO₂ for a 355 nm high reflector to widen the band puts TiO₂'s 3.3 eV gap below the 3.5 eV photon energy; the film absorbs directly, the threshold drops tenfold and ablation appears within minutes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：奈秒脈衝的損傷由缺陷吸收引發熱爆裂，飛秒脈衝則由多光子與雪崩游離主導，門檻隨材料能隙上升：SiO₂ 約 9 eV、HfO₂ 約 5.6 eV、Ta₂O₅ 約 4 eV、TiO₂ 約 3.3 eV，因此高損傷門檻鏡用 HfO₂/SiO₂，最低吸收鏡用 Ta₂O₅/SiO₂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nanosecond damage is initiated by defect absorption and thermal explosion, while femtosecond damage is dominated by multiphoton and avalanche ionisation whose threshold rises with band gap: about 9 eV for SiO₂, 5.6 eV for HfO₂, 4 eV for Ta₂O₅ and 3.3 eV for TiO₂, which is why high-threshold mirrors use HfO₂/SiO₂ and lowest-absorption mirrors Ta₂O₅/SiO₂.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射損傷總是從鏡片最外面的表面開始。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Laser damage always starts at the outermost surface of the mirror." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超拋光基板、散射與節瘤缺陷」與「離子束濺鍍、化學計量與退火」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Superpolished substrates, scatter and nodular defects" and "Ion-beam sputtering, stoichiometry and annealing": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超拋光基板、散射與節瘤缺陷：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Superpolished substrates, scatter and nodular defects: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鏡片的散射下限由基板粗糙度決定，膜層會複製基板的形貌。雷射鏡基板通常是熔融石英或低膨脹玻璃，經超拋光到 0.1 到 0.2 nm RMS，表面品質達 10-5 等級，並在潔淨室中清洗後立刻進入鍍膜腔。基板上任何殘留微粒在厚膜堆中會長成倒錐形的節瘤缺陷，節瘤直徑隨種子直徑與膜厚的乘積開平方增長，而節瘤邊界的場強集中使局部損傷門檻遠低於無缺陷區，所以損傷統計往往是由缺陷密度而非材料本質決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror's scatter floor is set by substrate roughness, which the film replicates. Laser-mirror substrates are usually fused silica or low-expansion glass superpolished to 0.1 to 0.2 nm RMS with 10-5 surface quality, cleaned in a clean room and loaded into the chamber immediately. Any residual particle on the substrate grows through a thick stack into an inverted-cone nodular defect whose diameter scales as the square root of seed diameter times film thickness, and field concentration at the nodule boundary makes the local damage threshold far lower than defect-free film, so damage statistics are often governed by defect density rather than intrinsic material limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總積分散射 S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²：σ = 0.1 nm、λ = 1064 nm 時 S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm；σ = 0.3 nm 時約 12.5 ppm，超過整個損耗預算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total integrated scatter S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²: with σ = 0.1 nm and λ = 1064 nm, S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm; with σ = 0.3 nm about 12.5 ppm, exceeding the whole loss budget.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要膜層夠好，基板的粗糙度與清潔度無關緊要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a good enough film the substrate's roughness and cleanliness do not matter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 超拋光基板、散射與節瘤缺陷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Superpolished substrates, scatter and nodular defects: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總積分散射 S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²：σ = 0.1 nm、λ = 1064 nm 時 S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm；σ = 0.3 nm 時約 12.5 ppm，超過整個損耗預算。節瘤直徑 D ≈ √(C·d·t)，取 C ≈ 8：直徑 d = 0.2 µm 的種子埋在 t = 5 µm 的膜堆下長成 D ≈ √(8×0.2×5) ≈ 2.8 µm 的節瘤；若每 cm² 有 10 個這種缺陷，直徑 2 mm 的光斑內平均有 0.3 個，損傷機率由缺陷密度主導。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total integrated scatter S ≈ (4πσ/λ)²: with σ = 0.1 nm and λ = 1064 nm, S ≈ (1.18×10⁻³)² ≈ 1.4 ppm; with σ = 0.3 nm about 12.5 ppm, exceeding the whole loss budget. Nodule diameter D ≈ √(C·d·t) with C ≈ 8: a seed of d = 0.2 µm under a t = 5 µm stack grows into D ≈ √(8×0.2×5) ≈ 2.8 µm; with 10 such defects per cm², a 2 mm diameter spot contains 0.3 on average, so damage probability is governed by defect density. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍膜前用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量基板粗糙度 PSD，預測散射並與鍍膜後的 TIS 量測比較；以暗場顯微鏡掃描鍍後表面統計節瘤密度與直徑分佈，用節瘤公式反推種子大小，並與損傷測試中損傷點位置做對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure substrate roughness PSD by white-light interferometry and AFM before coating, predict scatter and compare with post-coating TIS; map nodule density and diameter distribution by dark-field microscopy, infer seed size from the nodule relation and correlate with damage-site locations from threshold testing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 超拋光基板、散射與節瘤缺陷：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Superpolished substrates, scatter and nodular defects: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「超拋光基板與節瘤缺陷」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Superpolished substrate and nodular defects” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜前用白光干涉儀與 AFM 量基板粗糙度 PSD，預測散射並與鍍膜後的 TIS 量測比較；以暗場顯微鏡掃描鍍後表面統計節瘤密度與直徑分佈，用節瘤公式反推種子大小，並與損傷測試中損傷點位置做對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure substrate roughness PSD by white-light interferometry and AFM before coating, predict scatter and compare with post-coating TIS; map nodule density and diameter distribution by dark-field microscopy, infer seed size from the nodule relation and correlate with damage-site locations from threshold testing. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：基板從拋光廠到鍍膜腔之間放置數日，表面吸附微粒與有機物，鍍後節瘤密度升高十倍，散射 15 ppm 且 1-on-1 損傷門檻只有乾淨批次的一半。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Substrates left for days between the polishing shop and the chamber pick up particles and organics; after coating the nodule density is ten times higher, scatter reaches 15 ppm and the 1-on-1 threshold is half that of a clean batch.

steps.title: 離子束濺鍍、化學計量與退火：原理與系統邊界

steps.objective: 說明「離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射鏡幾乎都以離子束濺鍍沉積：氬離子束轟擊 Ta 或 Ta₂O₅ 靶，濺出的原子帶著數 eV 能量到達基板，形成緻密、非晶、低散射的膜，腔內通入氧氣維持氧化物的化學計量，否則缺氧的 TaOₓ 會帶來 ppm 以上的吸收。沉積速率只有約 0.1 nm/s，一片 41 層、6 µm 的鏡需十幾小時，過程中靶材老化與氧分壓漂移都會改變折射率。鍍後在數百度退火可以降低吸收與機械損耗並釋放部分壓應力，是重力波探測器鏡片與高精度腔鏡的標準工序。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Laser mirrors are almost always deposited by ion-beam sputtering: an argon-ion beam strikes a Ta or Ta₂O₅ target, the sputtered atoms arrive with several eV and form dense, amorphous, low-scatter films, and oxygen is admitted to keep the oxide stoichiometric, since oxygen-deficient TaOₓ brings absorption above ppm. The rate is only about 0.1 nm/s, so a 41-layer, 6 µm mirror takes well over ten hours, during which target ageing and oxygen-pressure drift alter the index. Post-deposition annealing at several hundred degrees lowers absorption and mechanical loss and relaxes part of the compressive stress, a standard step for gravitational-wave-detector mirrors and high-precision cavity mirrors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：吸收主要發生在場強最大的前幾個 Ta₂O₅ 層：場加權的有效 Ta₂O₅ 厚度 ≈ d_H × Σ0.91×0.48ᵏ × 0.5 ≈ 127 nm × 1.73 × 0.5 ≈ 110 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Absorption occurs mainly in the top Ta₂O₅ layers where the field is strongest: the field-weighted effective Ta₂O₅ thickness ≈ d_H × Σ0.91×0.48ᵏ × 0.5 ≈ 127 nm × 1.73 × 0.5 ≈ 110 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜完成後膜層性質就固定了，退火只是可有可無的額外步驟。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Film properties are fixed once deposition ends, so annealing is an optional extra." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離子束濺鍍腔、氧分壓與退火爐」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “IBS chamber, oxygen partial pressure and annealing furnace” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：吸收主要發生在場強最大的前幾個 Ta₂O₅ 層：場加權的有效 Ta₂O₅ 厚度 ≈ d_H × Σ0.91×0.48ᵏ × 0.5 ≈ 127 nm × 1.73 × 0.5 ≈ 110 nm。要使 A ≤ 1 ppm，需 α_H × 110 nm ≤ 10⁻⁶，即 α_H ≤ 0.09 cm⁻¹，換算消光係數 k = αλ/4π ≈ 0.09 × 1.064×10⁻⁴/12.6 ≈ 7.6×10⁻⁷。41 層總厚 20×(127 + 183) + 127 ≈ 6.3 µm，以 0.1 nm/s 沉積需 ≈ 17.6 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

The 41-layer total thickness is 20×(127 + 183) + 127 ≈ 6.3 µm, about 17.6 h at 0.1 nm/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用光熱共路干涉儀量退火前後的吸收，確認由數 ppm 降到 1 ppm 等級；以橢偏儀量單層 Ta₂O₅ 的 n、k，核對 k 是否低於 10⁻⁶；用薄片基板的曲率變化追蹤退火對壓應力的釋放，並以分光光度計確認退火後光譜位移小於 0.2%。

steps.title: ppm 損耗的量測：衰盪、光熱與散射：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Measuring ppm loss: ring-down, photothermal and scatter: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分光光度計的絕對精度約 0.1%，等於 1000 ppm，對雷射鏡毫無用處。損耗必須用光腔衰盪量測：把兩片鏡組成光腔，注入雷射後突然關斷，腔內光強以指數衰減，時間常數由腔長與鏡片總損耗決定，測時間比測光強準得多。吸收另以光熱共路干涉或光熱偏折量測，把泵浦雷射造成的微小熱膨脹與折射率變化轉成訊號，校正後可達 0.1 ppm；散射以總積分散射儀收集半球內的散射光。三者分別量測再相加，才是完整的損耗帳。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spectrophotometer's absolute accuracy of about 0.1% equals 1000 ppm and is useless for laser mirrors. Loss must be measured by cavity ring-down: two mirrors form a cavity, the laser is switched off abruptly, the stored light decays exponentially with a time constant set by cavity length and total mirror loss, and time is measured far more accurately than intensity. Absorption is measured separately by photothermal common-path interferometry or deflection, converting the tiny thermal expansion and index change produced by a pump laser into a signal with 0.1 ppm resolution after calibration; scatter is collected over a hemisphere by a total-integrated-scatter instrument. Only the three measured separately and summed form the complete ledger. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩片相同鏡、腔長 L 的衰盪時間 τ = L/[c·(1 − R)]。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For two identical mirrors in a cavity of length L the ring-down time is τ = L/[c·(1 − R)].
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分光光度計測到 99.99% 就證明鏡片損耗只有 100 ppm。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A spectrophotometer reading of 99.99% proves the mirror loses only 100 ppm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: ppm 損耗的量測：衰盪、光熱與散射：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measuring ppm loss: ring-down, photothermal and scatter: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光腔衰盪與光熱吸收量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cavity ring-down and photothermal absorption measurement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩片相同鏡、腔長 L 的衰盪時間 τ = L/[c·(1 − R)]。L = 0.5 m：R = 0.9999 時 τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 10⁻⁴) ≈ 16.7 µs；R = 0.99999 時 ≈ 167 µs；本課的 31 層鏡（1 − R = 25 ppm）τ ≈ 66.7 µs。若 τ 的量測精度為 1%，1 − R 的解析度約 0.25 ppm，遠優於任何光度法。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For two identical mirrors in a cavity of length L the ring-down time is τ = L/[c·(1 − R)]. With L = 0.5 m: τ = 0.5/(3×10⁸ × 10⁻⁴) ≈ 16.7 µs at R = 0.9999, about 167 µs at R = 0.99999, and about 66.7 µs for this course's 31-layer mirror (1 − R = 25 ppm). With τ measured to 1%, the resolution in 1 − R is about 0.25 ppm, far beyond any photometric method. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以三片鏡兩兩組腔做三次衰盪量測，解聯立方程得到每片鏡各自的損耗；把衰盪求得的 1 − R 與光熱吸收加 TIS 散射再加功率計量到的 T 相比，確認差異在 2 ppm 內；用已知損耗的參考鏡定期檢查衰盪裝置的對準與偵測器線性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure three mirrors pairwise in three ring-down cavities and solve the simultaneous equations for each mirror's individual loss; compare the ring-down 1 − R with photothermal absorption plus TIS scatter plus power-meter transmission, requiring agreement within 2 ppm; check the ring-down setup's alignment and detector linearity regularly with a reference mirror of known loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objective: 說明「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 損傷門檻依 ISO 21254 以 1-on-1（每點一發）或 S-on-1（每點多發）測試，在多個能量密度各打數十點，統計損傷機率對能量密度的曲線，把機率外推到零得到門檻，並記錄波長、脈寬、光斑大小、重複率與損傷判定方法。門檻隨脈寬在奈秒熱擴散區近似以平方根縮放，隨波長近似線性，光斑越大掃到缺陷的機率越高而門檻越低；這些縮放只是估計，跨越物理機制（例如進入飛秒區）時完全失效。工程上以高斯光束的峰值能量密度與門檻比較，並留二到五倍的安全係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thresholds are tested per ISO 21254 in 1-on-1 (one shot per site) or S-on-1 (many shots per site) mode: tens of sites are irradiated at each of several fluences, damage probability is plotted against fluence and extrapolated to zero probability, and wavelength, pulse width, spot size, repetition rate and the damage criterion are recorded. In the nanosecond thermal-diffusion regime the threshold scales roughly with the square root of pulse width and roughly linearly with wavelength, and larger spots find more defects and give lower thresholds; these scalings are estimates only and fail completely when the physics changes, as in the femtosecond regime. Engineering compares the Gaussian beam's peak fluence with the threshold and keeps a safety factor of two to five. steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 委託依 ISO 21254 的測試實驗室做 1-on-1 與 S-on-1，取得損傷機率曲線而不只是一個數字；在自己的系統上以 Nomarski 或暗場顯微鏡檢查曝照後的鏡面，與證書的損傷判定標準對照；把實際光斑與脈寬代入縮放公式，確認安全係數並記錄在規格表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Commission 1-on-1 and S-on-1 tests from an ISO 21254 laboratory and obtain the full damage-probability curve, not just a number; inspect the irradiated surface in your own system with Nomarski or dark-field microscopy against the certificate's damage criterion; substitute your actual spot and pulse width into the scaling relations to confirm the safety factor and record it on the specification sheet. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：把 10 ns 的證書門檻直接套用到 300 fs 雷射，飛秒損傷由能隙而非熱擴散決定，實際門檻只有換算值的幾十分之一，鏡片在首次滿功率時損傷；或以平均能量密度而非高斯峰值做比較，把安全係數高估一倍。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying a 10 ns certificate to a 300 fs laser, where damage is set by band gap rather than thermal diffusion, overestimates the threshold by tens of times and the mirror fails at first full power; comparing average instead of Gaussian peak fluence doubles the apparent safety factor.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.titleEn: Damage-threshold testing, scaling laws and safety factor: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「ISO 21254 損傷測試與脈寬縮放表」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “ISO 21254 damage test and pulse-width scaling table” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 把 10 ns 的證書門檻直接套用到 300 fs 雷射，飛秒損傷由能隙而非熱擴散決定，實際門檻只有換算值的幾十分之一，鏡片在首次滿功率時損傷；或以平均能量密度而非高斯峰值做比較，把安全係數高估一倍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染」與「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連續波高功率下，鏡片吸收的功率在光斑中心形成溫度峰，熱膨脹把表面頂成一個凸起，反射波前因此帶有離焦與球差，腔的穩定區隨功率漂移；基板熱導率越高、光斑越大，溫升越小。安裝時的夾持力會在面形上壓出像散，所以用三點運動學或撓性座並控制扭矩。污染是壽命殺手：鏡面吸附的碳氫化合物在紫外或高功率下碳化，形成吸收中心並降低門檻，真空或密閉腔內必須控制除氣材料並維持潔淨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under high continuous-wave power the absorbed power forms a temperature peak at the beam centre, thermal expansion raises a bump on the surface, the reflected wavefront acquires defocus and spherical aberration, and the cavity stability region drifts with power; higher substrate conductivity and larger spots reduce the rise. Clamping forces during mounting press astigmatism into the figure, so three-point kinematic or flexure mounts with controlled torque are used. Contamination is the lifetime killer: adsorbed hydrocarbons carbonise under ultraviolet or high power, forming absorption centres and lowering the threshold, so outgassing materials in sealed or vacuum cavities must be controlled and cleanliness maintained. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡片驗收合格後，安裝與使用環境不會再改變它的性能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a mirror passes acceptance, mounting and the operating environment cannot change its performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：高斯光束在半無限基板表面的中心溫升 ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w)。10 kW 入射、A = 10 ppm → P_abs = 0.1 W；熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、w = 2 mm：ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K；表面凸起 ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm，反射波前變形約 30 nm ≈ λ/35。改用 κ = 400 W/(m·K) 的銅基板，ΔT ≈ 0.05 K。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The centre temperature rise of a Gaussian beam on a semi-infinite substrate is ΔT ≈ P_abs/(√(2π)·κ·w). With 10 kW incident and A = 10 ppm, P_abs = 0.1 W; for fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K) and w = 2 mm, ΔT ≈ 0.1/(2.51×1.38×0.002) ≈ 14 K; the surface bump ≈ α·ΔT·w ≈ 0.55×10⁻⁶ × 14 × 2 mm ≈ 15 nm, a reflected-wavefront distortion of about 30 nm ≈ λ/35. A copper substrate with κ = 400 W/(m·K) gives ΔT ≈ 0.05 K. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: High-power thermal lensing, mounting stress and contamination: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在功率逐步上升時用 Hartmann 或干涉儀量反射波前，擷取離焦項隨功率的斜率並與熱模型比較；安裝前後各量一次面形，相減得到夾持像散並調整扭矩直到小於 λ/50；以表面分析或在線監測吸收的時間趨勢判斷污染累積。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the reflected wavefront with a Hartmann sensor or interferometer while stepping up power, extract the slope of the defocus term against power and compare with the thermal model; measure figure before and after mounting, subtract to obtain clamping astigmatism and adjust torque until it is below λ/50; judge contamination build-up from surface analysis or the time trend of in-line absorption. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 高功率熱透鏡、安裝應力與污染：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高功率熱效應、安裝與污染控制」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “High-power thermal effects, mounting and contamination control” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡片以彈簧壓片硬夾，面形出現 λ/8 的像散使腔模式變橢圓；腔內使用的黏著劑除氣，三個月後鏡面吸收從 2 ppm 升到 30 ppm，輸出功率逐週下降。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A mirror hard-clamped by a spring retainer carries λ/8 of astigmatism and the cavity mode turns elliptical; an outgassing adhesive inside the cavity raises surface absorption from 2 ppm to 30 ppm within three months and the output power declines week by week. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」如何決定高反射雷射鏡片的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” determines the key performance of “High-reflectivity laser mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雷射鏡規格表必須分項列出：工作波長與入射角、偏振、T、A、S 各自的上限與量測方法、損傷門檻及其測試條件、面形與表面品質、超快應用的群延遲色散、以及清潔方式限制。驗收以衰盪與光熱量測為準，並設保護帶。系統端把每片鏡的損耗代入腔的往返損耗，計算精細度與腔內功率增益，確認與設計一致。交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A laser-mirror specification must itemise working wavelength and incidence angle, polarization, separate ceilings and measurement methods for T, A and S, the damage threshold with its test conditions, figure and surface quality, group-delay dispersion for ultrafast use, and cleaning limits. Acceptance relies on ring-down and photothermal measurements with a guard band. The system side enters each mirror's loss into the cavity round-trip loss to compute finesse and intracavity power build-up and checks them against the design. The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：兩片鏡各 T = 10 ppm、A = 2 ppm、S = 3 ppm，往返損耗 ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm，精細度 F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵，腔內功率增益 ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴；若某片鏡 S 升到 13 ppm，ℓ = 40 ppm，F 降到 1.6×10⁵。衰盪驗收保護帶：規格 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm、量測不確定度 1 ppm，則判定門檻為 24 ppm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Two mirrors each with T = 10 ppm, A = 2 ppm and S = 3 ppm give a round-trip loss ℓ = 2×15 ppm = 30 ppm, finesse F ≈ 2π/ℓ ≈ 2.1×10⁵ and intracavity build-up ≈ F/π ≈ 6.7×10⁴; if one mirror's S rises to 13 ppm, ℓ = 40 ppm and F falls to 1.6×10⁵. Ring-down guard band: with a specification of 1 − R ≤ 25 ppm and 1 ppm measurement uncertainty, the pass threshold is 24 ppm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

With a good enough film the substrate's roughness and cleanliness do not matter.
A spectrophotometer reading of 99.99% proves the mirror loses only 100 ppm.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record and that the damage certificate's pulse width and wavelength match the use conditions or have been properly scaled. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A sheet reading R > 99.99% and high damage threshold without itemised terms or test conditions is met with a spectrophotometer reading and an unspecified-pulse threshold; the cavity reaches a quarter of the designed finesse, the mirror fails at full power and responsibility cannot be assigned.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準；核對規格表每一項都有對應的量測紀錄與條件，並確認損傷證書的脈寬與波長與使用條件一致或已正確縮放。
knowledge.textEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Check that every specification line has a matching measurement record and that the damage certificate's pulse width and wavelength match the use conditions or have been properly scaled.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
把鏡片裝入實際腔體後量精細度（由共振線寬或衰盪求得），與各鏡損耗相加的預測比較，差異大於 20% 時回頭檢查安裝污染與對準。
損傷門檻是鏡片的固定材料常數，與脈寬、波長和光斑無關。

After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses.
The damage threshold is a fixed material constant independent of pulse width, wavelength and spot size.

quiz.explanationEn: After installing the mirrors in the real cavity, measure finesse from resonance linewidth or ring-down and compare with the prediction summed from individual losses; a discrepancy above 20% sends you back to mounting contamination and alignment. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷射鏡規格表與損耗預算交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Laser-mirror specification sheet and loss-budget handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A sheet reading R > 99.99% and high damage threshold without itemised terms or test conditions is met with a spectrophotometer reading and an unspecified-pulse threshold; the cavity reaches a quarter of the designed finesse, the mirror fails at full power and responsibility cannot be assigned. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接資料含鍍膜批號、見證片衰盪紀錄、損傷證書、退火紀錄與基板來源，使未來任何一片鏡的異常都能回溯到製程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff holds the coating run number, witness ring-down records, damage certificate, annealing record and substrate origin, so any later anomaly in any mirror can be traced to its process.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雷射鏡規格只需要反射率百分比和一個損傷門檻數字。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A laser-mirror specification needs only a reflectance percentage and one damage-threshold number." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 規格表寫「R > 99.99%、高損傷門檻」而沒有分項與測試條件，供應商以分光光度計與未註明脈寬的門檻交貨，腔的精細度只達設計的四分之一且鏡片在滿功率下損傷，雙方無法釐清責任。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規格表、腔損耗預算與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Specification sheet, cavity loss budget and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
多加幾對膜層就能讓雷射鏡的損耗無限趨近於零。

Adding more layer pairs drives a laser mirror's loss arbitrarily close to zero.
